result.title: Synergizing Evidence Retrieval and Utilization for Self-Improving Multimodal Scientific Document Reasoning
result.summary: Scientific document reasoning requires an agent to acquire and integrate evidence distributed across text, figures, and tables. Retrieval can identify relevant sources while missing complementary support, and answer-level feedback alone does not reveal whether an error stems from evidence acquisition or evidence use. We present an agentic Retriever--Perceiver--Reasoner framework for multimodal scientific document reasoning. The Retriever sequentially selects source-aligned evidence under a context budget. Given the selected evidence and question, the Perceiver constructs a question-conditioned latent ontology, an implicit organization of multimodal evidence in a shared continuous space. The Reasoner combines this latent guidance with the original sources to produce grounded answers. We train the three components through diagnostic-guided co-evolution: alternating updates optimize them with a shared answering reward, while Retrieval Potential Feedback (RPF) and Latent Efficacy Feedback (LEF) identify questions that need better retrieval or latent guidance and direct targeted resampling. Across four benchmarks and seven evaluation settings, our framework obtains average scores of 69.9 and 75.0 with 7B and 8B Reasoner backbones, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.0 and 9.1 points, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Retriever–Perceiver–Reasoner 智能体框架，做多模态科学文档问答：先按上下文预算逐步检索文本、图表证据，再由 Perceiver 在连续空间构造问题条件化的 latent ontology 引导 Reasoner 生成有据答案，并用检索潜力与 latent 效力两类反馈定位错误来源、协同训练各组件。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 latent ontology 可视为对多模态证据的隐式组织与筛选，LEF 试图区分「检索不足」与「latent 引导无效」，与视觉证据筛选、信息坍缩及证据获取/使用的贡献分配直接相关，可供核查 latent 内容是否真被答案使用。
